messages.content: 你能幫我找到紐約有閱讀室和小說區的公共圖書館，然後在洛杉磯有Wi-Fi和有兒童區的公共圖書館，最後在芝加哥有咖啡廳和閱讀室的公共圖書館嗎？

The facilities parameter can be one of the listed options: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[].

But the user wants multiple facilities per location. The function signature seems to allow only one facility? It says facilities: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[]. That suggests that facilities can be a single string or an array of strings? Actually "Cafe"[] indicates array of Cafe? Wait "Cafe"[] means array of "Cafe"? That seems odd. Maybe they want to pass an array of strings? The type is ambiguous. But we can pass an array of strings: ["Reading Room", "Fiction"] etc.

Thus we will call the function three times:

1. location: "New York, NY", facilities: ["Reading Room", "Fiction"]
2. location: "Los Angeles, CA", facilities: ["Wi-Fi", "Children Section"]
3. location: "Chicago, IL", facilities: ["Cafe", "Reading Room"]
